applyOnDamage.name: On Damage
applyOnDamage.hint: Prompt for a lingering injury roll when a single instance of damage is at least the threshold below.

damageThreshold.name: Damage Threshold
damageThreshold.hint: Fraction of maximum hit points a single instance of damage must reach to prompt a lingering injury roll (0.5 = half).

applyOnDown.name: On Unconscious
applyOnDown.hint: Prompt for a lingering injury roll when damage brings an actor to 0 hit points.

applyOnCritSave.name: On Fumbled Saving Throw
applyOnCritSave.hint: Prompt for a lingering injury roll when damage comes from a saving throw the actor rolled a natural 1 on.

applyOnCrit.name: On Critical Hit
applyOnCrit.hint: Prompt for a lingering injury roll when the actor takes damage from a critical hit.

triggerNpc.name: Trigger Injuries on NPCs
triggerNpc.hint: Enables the automations on actors without a player owner.

selfdestruct.name: Remove Expired Injuries
selfdestruct.hint: When all of an injury's effects expire, delete the injury item from the actor.

autoApplyOngoing.name: Auto Apply Ongoing Damage
autoApplyOngoing.hint: Automatically apply ongoing injury damage (burning, poison, bleeding) at turn start/end. When disabled a damage card is posted to apply manually.

dialog.selectDamageType: Select the correct Damage Type before rolling on the table.
dialog.damagePrompt: How much damage caused {injury}? Some injury effects scale with it.

reasons.damage: Damage exceeded the threshold of maximum hit points

notifications.noActor: No token selected or actor found!
notifications.noInjury: The injury linked to this result could not be found.
